name: Scott B.
text: Queens Auto and Gio are excellent. They stepped up with fantastic customer service when our transmission needed repair. We’re from out of state so the logistics were a bit challenging but Gio was very easy to work with and he kept us informed throughout the whole process. Highly recommend.

name: Joe W.
text: Great experience from start to finish. Honest, professional, and clearly knew what they are doing. Gio explains everything clearly, doesn’t try to push unnecessary repairs, and gets the job done quickly. The pricing was fair, and my truck is running great. I’d definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a trustworthy mechanic!

name: PoPzQ
text: Honest diagnosis, fair price, and repair done right the first time. Rare and impressive.

name: Kim B.
text: Very thorough when it comes to diagnosing the service needed, they don't temporarily patch things up unlike a lot of shops in Elgin, they won't break the bank either. Lex has definitely become a trusted name in my household. My best friend recommended this shop now my husband, son and parents TRUST this shop. KUDOS Queens auto shop for winning my business because nowadays that's hard for me to TRUST anyone.

name: Mike V.
text: Had a great experience here, fair prices and quick repair. Gio was awesome and really helped take care of the issue quick. I was in and out, they were very professional. Would definitely recommend coming here!

name: Caesar J.
text: This is a great neighborhood auto repair shop, the mechanics and management work hand in hand and the pricing is very reasonable for any type of repair you need to have done. Lifer for all of my vehicles.
